purpose: Selects page-type path templates for a site: one named template, or the path clusters of its multi-page sessions over a session floor and a share floor.
data: Journey subjects, most sessions first, each with its template steps, its sessions after the confirmed-bot filter, and its share of the multi-page sessions.

path.description: a template of 2 to 6 page types joined by >, such as home>collection>product; types: home, product, collection, cart, search, content, checkout, account, other, unknown

depth.description: the steps a cluster keeps; 3 when absent

minClusterShare.description: share of multi-page sessions; 0.02 when absent
